title: Workstation Engineer
description: Join a global Contract Resource Organization (CRO) where innovation meets purpose. At Worldwide Clinical Trials , we're driven by a shared commitment to improving lives through high-quality clinical research. Our teams are empowered to think creatively, take ownership, and deliver meaningful work that helps bring life-changing therapies to patients around the world. With more than 4,000 professionals across the globe, we foster a collaborative and inclusive environment where diverse perspectives are valued, growth is encouraged, and every contribution makes an impact. Whether you're building your career or bringing years of experience, you'll have the opportunity to learn, grow, and help shape the future of clinical research. SUMMARY: The Workstation Engineer is responsible for the design, lifecycle management, security, standardization, and continuous improvement of Worldwide's end-user computing environment. This role ensures that employee devices, operating systems, endpoint management platforms, and productivity tools remain secure, reliable, compliant, and aligned with business needs. The Workstation Engineer evaluates emerging technologies, maintains endpoint technology roadmaps, manages hardware and software standards, validates compatibility, administers endpoint management solutions, and supports the deployment of secure workstation technologies across a global enterprise environment. The role works closely with Security, Infrastructure, Service Desk, Procurement, and business stakeholders to deliver a modern digital workplace experience. Industry best practices emphasize endpoint lifecycle management, modern device management, cloud-managed endpoints, automation, and Zero Trust security principles. RESPONSIBILITIE S Tasks may include but are not limited to Endpoint Strategy & Roadmap Own and maintain the global workstation hardware roadmap. Define and manage approved standards for laptops, desktops, monitors, docking stations, peripherals, and mobile computing devices. Develop lifecycle and refresh strategies for end-user hardware. Recommend future-state endpoint solutions aligned with business, security, and operational requirements. Collaborate with Procurement and vendors to evaluate new hardware platforms and technologies. Technology Evaluation & Innovation Research, evaluate, and assess new endpoint technologies, operating systems, management tools, and productivity solutions. Conduct proofs of concept (POCs) and pilot programs for emerging technologies. Evaluate compatibility, supportability, security risks, and operational impact of new solutions. Provide recommendations based on technical, business, security, and user experience considerations. Hardware & Software Compatibility Testing Design, coordinate, and execute testing activities for workstation hardware, operating systems, drivers, applications, and peripherals. Validate compatibility between business applications and supported endpoint platforms. Develop testing standards, procedures, and acceptance criteria. Document findings and support enterprise-wide deployment decisions. Endpoint Engineering & Administration Engineer, deploy, and maintain Windows and macOS workstation environments. Manage endpoint configuration standards and images. Configure and support endpoint management platforms such as Microsoft Intune, Autopilot, Jamf, and related technologies. Develop automation and self-service solutions to improve endpoint management and user experience. Create and maintain endpoint configuration, compliance, and security policies. Patch & Vulnerability Management Test, validate, and deploy operating system, driver, firmware, and application updates. Assess software patches for potential business impact prior to enterprise deployment. Develop deployment schedules and rollout strategies. Monitor patch compliance and remediation activities. Partner with Cybersecurity teams to address endpoint vulnerabilities and reduce risk exposure. Security & Compliance Support Zero Trust and endpoint security initiatives. Ensure workstation configurations comply with organizational security standards and regulatory requirements. Partner with Security teams to implement endpoint protection, encryption, device compliance, and conditional access controls. Participate in security reviews, audits, and compliance assessments. Operational Support Serve as Tier 3 escalation support for complex workstation-related incidents and problems. Perform root cause analysis and drive permanent corrective actions. Engage vendors and manufacturers to resolve product defects and technical issues. Support major incidents impacting endpoint services. Documentation & Process Improvement Develop and maintain technical standards, procedures, runbooks, and knowledge articles. Maintain endpoint architecture documentation and hardware standards catalogs. Continuously improve workstation deployment, support, and lifecycle processes. Identify opportunities for automation and operational efficiency. Project Participation Lead or participate in endpoint modernization initiatives. Support workstation-related workstreams for mergers, acquisitions, office openings, and technology refresh projects. Collaborate with Infrastructure, Cloud, Networking, Cybersecurity, and Service Desk teams to deliver endpoint solutions. OTHER SKILLS AND ABILITIES: Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills. Technology evaluation and decision-making. Project and change management. Process improvement mindset. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Ability to balance security, usability, and operational requirements. Vendor management and stakeholder engagement. Documentation and knowledge management. Customer-focused approach. Ability to work independently in a global environment. Success Measures The Workstation Engineer will be measured on: Endpoint compliance and security posture. Hardware roadmap effectiveness and lifecycle management. Patch compliance and vulnerability remediation performance. Device reliability and user experience metrics. Reduction in endpoint-related incidents. Successful delivery of endpoint modernization initiatives. Automation and operational efficiency improvements. Quality of documentation and technical standards. REQUIREMENTS: Education Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or related field. Equivalent combination of education and relevant experience may be considered. Experience 5+ years of experience in endpoint engineering, workstation engineering, desktop engineering, or end-user computing. Experience managing enterprise-scale Windows workstation environments. Experience with endpoint lifecycle management and hardware standardization. Experience testing and validating hardware and software compatibility. Experience managing software deployment and patch management processes. Technical Skills Windows 10/11 administration and engineering. Microsoft Intune and Endpoint Manager. Windows Autopilot. Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD). Microsoft 365 platform. PowerShell scripting and automation. Endpoint security technologies. Software packaging and deployment. Hardware lifecycle and asset management. Driver and firmware management. Device compliance and configuration management. Remote support and endpoint troubleshooting. Preferred Qualifications Experience supporting macOS environments. Experience with Jamf Pro. Experience with Azure Virtual Desktop or other virtual desktop technologies. Experience with Tanium or similar endpoint management platforms. Experience with Digital Experience Monitoring (DEX/DEM) tools. ITIL Foundation certification. Microsoft Certified: Endpoint Administrator Associate. Microsoft Certified: Modern Desktop Administrator (or successor certification). Experience operating within a regulated environment such as healthcare, clinical research, pharmaceutical, or life sciences industries. Promotion to the next level is not automatic based on years of experience. Personnel are evaluated on proven competency, level of responsibility, and ability to work independently. Discover the Difference We love knowing that someone is going to have a better life because of the work we do. Discover the Difference at Worldwide Clinical Trials. Explore additional opportunities on our careers page, visit http://www.worldwide.com/careers , or connect with us on LinkedIn .
company_description:
Worldwide Clinical Trials (Worldwide) is a leading full-service global contract research organization (CRO) that works in partnership with biotechnology and pharmaceutical companies to create customized solutions that advance new medications – from discovery to reality.  

Anchored in our company’s scientific heritage, our dedicated therapeutic focus on cardiovascular, metabolic, neuroscience, oncology, and rare diseases, is applied to develop flexible plans and solve problems quickly for our customers.  Our capabilities include bioanalytical laboratory services, Phase I-IV clinical trials, and post-approval and real-world evidence studies – all powered by our team members who bring their expertise and a collaborative, personalized approach to each clinical program.

We’re a team of clinicians, scientists, and researchers who want to make healthcare better. We were founded on an unwavering commitment to authentic, personalized attention. And today, as CROs consolidate and the industry changes rapidly, that personalized attention is more important than ever.

Our talented team of 3,000+ professionals spans 60+ countries, and embraces a culture of diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging (DEI&B). We are united in cause with our customers to improve the lives of patients through new, innovative therapies. We believe everyone plays an important role in making a world of difference for patients and their caregivers. From our hands-on, accessible leaders, to our cohesive and supportive teams, we are committed to enabling professionals from all backgrounds and experiences to succeed.

We prioritize cultivating a diverse and inclusive environment that continues to promote collaboration and creativity. We are proud to be a workplace where people thrive by being themselves and are inspired to do their best work every day. 

To learn more about Worldwide, visit www.Worldwide.com or connect with us on LinkedIn.

title: Senior Systems Virtualization Engineer
description: Job Title: Systems Virtualization Engineer Experience: 10+ Years Work Mode: Remote Location: Remote Employment Type: Full-Time Company Overview Nuventure Connect is an ISO 27001:2022 and SOC 2 certified technology services company that leverages deep technology expertise to solve complex business problems and empower clients worldwide. Our commitment to state-of-the-art solutions spans the entire product value chain, delivering next-generation software, end-to-end IoT solutions, cloud infrastructure management, and managed IT support services. About the Role Nuventure Connect is looking for an experienced and highly motivated Virtualization Engineer to join our Engineering team. In this role, you will be responsible for designing, deploying, managing, securing, and optimizing enterprise virtualization platforms across multiple customer environments. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in VMware technologies, enterprise backup solutions, storage infrastructure, virtualization lifecycle management, disaster recovery, and infrastructure troubleshooting. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver reliable, secure, and scalable virtualization services while maintaining high operational standards. Key Responsibilities Design, implement, document, maintain, secure, and continuously improve virtualization infrastructure across multiple sites and customer environments. Administer VMware vSphere and related virtualization platforms, including clusters, hosts, virtual machines, templates, host profiles, vMotion, resource allocation, lifecycle management, and platform licensing. Install, configure, test, patch, upgrade, and maintain operating systems, platform software, and systems management tools in accordance with approved standards and change-control processes. Monitor platform health, performance, capacity, and availability; identify trends and remediate risks before they affect customers or service commitments. Provide Tier 2 and Tier 3 support for escalated incidents, service requests, problems, and projects involving managed infrastructure and technologies; perform root-cause analysis and drive issues through resolution. Design and execute migration and onboarding strategies for customer workloads and internal platforms, including discovery, dependency validation, testing, cutover, rollback planning, and post-migration stabilization. Evaluate and implement storage, backup, replication, and disaster-recovery solutions aligned with customer requirements, recovery objectives, security controls, and operational standards. Collaborate professionally with customers, vendors, Engineering, Support, Network, Security, and leadership to design, implement, and support reliable services. Develop and maintain accurate architecture diagrams, standards, runbooks, knowledge articles, configuration records, ticket updates, and shift-handoff documentation. Provide technical leadership, coaching, and knowledge transfer to colleagues on virtualization technologies, operational practices, and troubleshooting methods. Meet assigned service, quality, project, and operational performance objectives; maintain relevant technical knowledge and certifications; and participate in the Engineering team’s rotating on-call schedule within a standard 40-hour workweek. Required Education and Experience Five or more years of professional experience administering complex, multi-site enterprise VMware environments, including vSphere clusters, ESXi hosts, vCenter, host profiles, templates and customization, vMotion, deployment, configuration, upgrades, and ongoing maintenance. Hands-on experience building, deploying, supporting, and maintaining virtual machines and the underlying compute, storage, and network integrations. Practical experience administering multi-tenant Veeam environments, including Veeam Backup & Replication, Veeam Cloud Connect, backup and restore operations, monitoring, troubleshooting, and recovery validation. Experience supporting data protection, replication, or recovery technologies such as Zerto and OpenText, or comparable enterprise platforms. Working knowledge of enterprise storage technologies, including NAS, SAN, and iSCSI, and their integration with virtualized environments. Working knowledge of core networking concepts, including VLANs, firewalls, load balancers, NAT, DNS, and LAN/WAN connectivity. Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot complex infrastructure issues methodically, assess risk, exercise sound judgment, and communicate technical findings clearly. Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to create operational documentation and work effectively with customers and cross-functional teams in a remote environment. Proven ability to organize and prioritize concurrent operational issues, escalations, and project commitments while maintaining accuracy and meeting deadlines. Preferred Skills Administration of additional virtualization or cloud platforms, including Proxmox VE, Microsoft Hyper-V, or Red Hat OpenShift Virtualization. VMware Horizon or hosted desktop-as-a-service environments. VMware NSX-T or comparable software-defined networking technologies; legacy NSX-V experience is also valuable. Technical leadership of virtualization, storage, migration, or infrastructure modernization projects. Hyperconverged infrastructure technologies and enterprise capacity planning. Infrastructure security, hardening, vulnerability remediation, backup immutability, and recovery testing. Experience supporting multiple customer environments within a managed services provider. Desired Competencies Veeam Certified Engineer (VMCE) or equivalent advanced Veeam certification. VMware Certified Professional, Data Center Virtualization (VCP-DCV), or higher. ITIL Foundation or higher. Alignment with Nuventure Values At Nuventure, how we work is as important as what we deliver. Team members are expected to demonstrate Nuventure's core values: Customer Focus: Place customers at the center of decisions and service delivery. Will-Do Attitude: Approach challenges with initiative, accountability, and a focus on creating customer value. Collaboration: Work responsively and constructively with others toward shared outcomes. Core Competencies Customer focus and professional service delivery. Ownership and accountability from initial identification through verified resolution. Analytical thinking, disciplined troubleshooting, and practical problem-solving. Attention to detail, sound organization, and consistent follow-through. Calm, clear communication during complex incidents and customer-impacting events. Collaboration, receptiveness to direction and feedback, and willingness to share knowledge. Continuous learning and adaptability as platforms, standards, and business requirements evolve.

description: Senior Analytics Engineer, Developer Productivity & DevSecOps About the role We are looking for an Senior Analytics Engineer to build and maintain the data pipelines, metrics, dashboards, and reports that measure the impact of our DevSecOps transformation program on the developer community. This role combines data engineering, analytics, and reporting with an understanding of how software is developed and delivered. You will work with program leaders, development teams, platform teams, and data engineering teams to turn data from developer tools and enterprise systems into reliable insights. Your work will help us understand tool adoption, guide migrations between platforms, identify delivery bottlenecks, and evaluate changes in developer productivity, software quality, and operational reliability. You will deliver rapid reporting prototypes, develop maintained reporting solutions, and serve as the curator of our metric definitions. Key responsibilities Build dashboards and reports. Develop and maintain Power BI reporting across software delivery performance, developer activity, tool adoption, onboarding, quality, reliability, and AI tool usage. Deliver rapid prototypes. Respond quickly to emerging questions with practical Excel analyses, preliminary dashboards, and reports built from available data. Convert CSV and JSON extracts into usable reporting, validate initial findings, and refine requirements with stakeholders. Develop prototypes into maintained solutions where needed. Discover and understand data sources. Identify the systems, APIs, tables, and extracts needed to answer reporting questions. Understand how source data is generated, what it represents, and the limitations that affect its use. Build and coordinate data pipelines. Use Python, SQL, and appropriate platform capabilities to extract, transform, and load reporting data. Partner with Databricks and other data engineering teams when they own upstream pipelines, and help resolve data access, integration, and refresh issues. Develop consistent data models and calculations. Combine data across systems, reconcile developer identities, connect activity to organizational structures, and implement consistent reporting populations, time periods, and calculation logic. Measure adoption and migration. Establish tool usage baselines, track movement from existing platforms to replacements, and identify adoption gaps, inactive users, and opportunities to improve license utilization. Analyze development and delivery workflows. Engineer DORA and related metrics, including deployment frequency, lead time for changes, coding and review times, commit activity, pull request and merge request activity, and work progress captured in Jira. Evaluate AI adoption and outcomes. Report on access, engagement, and usage of AI development tools. Use appropriate baseline, trend, and group comparisons to assess relationships between adoption and development outcomes. Own and curate metric definitions. Maintain a shared metric dictionary covering each measure’s purpose, calculation, data sources, reporting population, time periods, exclusions, assumptions, and limitations. Coordinate agreement on definitions and manage changes to preserve consistency. Explain and interpret the metrics. Serve as the point of reference for what each metric means, how it is calculated, and how it should be used. Investigate questions about reported figures and explain findings clearly to technical and business audiences. Maintain reporting reliability. Validate accuracy, completeness, and freshness; investigate discrepancies; troubleshoot failed pipelines and report refreshes; maintain appropriate access controls; and document how reported measures trace back to their sources. Required skills and experience Power BI: Practical experience building and maintaining dashboards, reports, and data models, including DAX, Power Query, scheduled refreshes, and row level security. SQL: Strong ability to write, troubleshoot, and optimize queries involving complex joins, aggregations, window functions, and time based calculations. Databricks: Experience querying and preparing data, working with Unity Catalog catalogs, schemas, tables, and views, and collaborating with teams responsible for data access and pipelines. Python: Practical experience extracting, cleaning, transforming, and validating data, integrating with APIs, and automating recurring data processes. Data integration and modeling: Experience building or maintaining ETL/ELT processes, combining data from multiple systems, and working with API authentication, CSV files, and JSON data. Excel: Proficiency in importing and transforming extracts, preparing and reconciling data, and building prototype analyses and reports using Power Query, formulas, and pivot tables. Software development lifecycle: Intermediate understanding of Git version control, commits, branching, pull requests, merge requests, code review, testing, CI/CD pipelines, and production deployments. Ability to connect these workflows to the data used to measure them. Analytical judgment: Ability to define meaningful measures, validate assumptions, distinguish activity and adoption from outcomes, and explain what the available evidence supports. Responsiveness and ownership: Ability to work with incomplete or evolving requirements, deliver useful initial analyses quickly, apply appropriate validation, and carry reporting work through delivery and ongoing maintenance. Communication and collaboration: Ability to translate stakeholder questions into data requirements, coordinate across teams, document definitions and decisions, and explain calculations and findings clearly. Preferred skills and experience Familiarity with reporting data from Jira, GitLab, GitHub, GitHub Copilot, Databricks Assistant, ServiceNow, workforce systems, or learning management systems. Experience measuring developer productivity, DevSecOps transformation, software delivery performance, or technology adoption. Experience working with Excel, CSV, and other supplemental reporting inputs stored in SharePoint. Experience using AI coding assistants such as Codex to accelerate data manipulation, Python and SQL development, analysis, and reporting automation, with the ability to review and validate generated code and outputs. What success looks like Stakeholders receive timely, useful reporting supported by dependable data processes and clearly defined metrics. Emerging questions can be answered quickly through validated prototypes, and recurring needs become maintained reporting solutions. Reported figures can be traced to their sources, definitions are consistently understood, and insights help teams make informed decisions about the DevSecOps transformation program.
